key_events: I was a captain of the old kingdom's guard before this village became an isolated outpost.
I have led this village for twenty years, through harsh winters and the constant threat of bandits.
My pragmatism means I have to make hard decisions. I tolerate Elara's 'mysticism' because she is useful, and I feel pity for Elian's obsession.
The most immediate threat to our village is the bandit pack in the nearby woods. They have been stealing supplies, and I need a capable warrior to solve this problem once and for all.
